mapper.select: select r.id, r.member_id, r.activity_id, r.topic_id, r.play_instance_id, r.config_version, r.status, r.completed_at from topic_route_session r join ( select max(id) as id from topic_route_session where member_id = #{memberId} group by activity_id, topic_id ) latest on latest.id = r.id where r.member_id = #{memberId} and r.status = 1 order by r.topic_id, r.activity_id, r.id

select q.input_id, q.member_id as requested_member_id, q.activity_id as requested_activity_id, q.topic_id as requested_topic_id, q.node_id as requested_node_id, coalesce(q.requested_instance, r.play_instance_id, 'default') as resolved_play_instance_id, r.id as route_session_id, r.config_version as frozen_config_version, p.id, p.member_id, p.activity_id, p.topic_id, p.node_id, p.play_instance_id, p.status, p.checkin_time, p.pic_url, p.review_status, p.longitude, p.latitude, p.puzzle_score, p.completion_mode, p.del_flag, p.create_time from (
select cast(#{request.inputId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} as char(80)) as input_id, cast(#{request.memberId,jdbcType=BIGINT} as signed) as member_id, cast(#{request.activityId,jdbcType=BIGINT} as signed) as activity_id, cast(#{request.topicId,jdbcType=BIGINT} as signed) as topic_id, cast(#{request.nodeId,jdbcType=BIGINT} as signed) as node_id, cast(#{request.playInstanceId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} as char(64)) as requested_instance
select null as input_id, null as member_id, null as activity_id, null as topic_id, null as node_id, null as requested_instance where 1=0
) q left join topic_route_session r on r.member_id = q.member_id and r.activity_id = q.activity_id and r.topic_id = q.topic_id and ((q.requested_instance is not null and r.play_instance_id = q.requested_instance) or (q.requested_instance is null and r.id = ( select max(current_run.id) from topic_route_session current_run where current_run.member_id = q.member_id and current_run.activity_id = q.activity_id and current_run.topic_id = q.topic_id))) left join player_node_progress p on p.member_id = q.member_id and p.activity_id = q.activity_id and p.topic_id = q.topic_id and p.node_id = q.node_id and p.play_instance_id = coalesce(q.requested_instance, r.play_instance_id, 'default') and p.del_flag = 0 where q.member_id = #{memberId} and #{memberId} > 0 order by q.input_id, p.id
